blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: A queue is first-in, first-out (FIFO). Enqueue joins the rear; Dequeue removes from the front.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Queues are suitable for ordered service requests such as print jobs or breadth-first exploration, if the queueing policy is FIFO.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Peek does not remove. Guard Dequeue/Peek with Count>0. Queue<T> handles storage internally; an explicit circular array queue instead tracks front, rear and count and wraps indexes modulo capacity (revisited in Lesson 197).

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace and justify
